types.definition: A registered data occurrence or derived representation within a checked source ownership boundary.
The primary kind of this admitted occurrence has not been established; not a wildcard and not a negative type assertion.
A file occurrence bound to its checked source revision and provider path identity.
A file whose exact basename is AGENTS.md under the named v1 classifier. The role asserts neither Markdown validity nor trust, applicability, or instruction authority.
A file declared to carry SQL by the checked source role or the exact lowercase .sql suffix rule; successful SQL parsing and dialect are separate.
A file declared to carry JSON by the checked source role or the exact lowercase .json suffix rule; successful strict-profile parsing is separate.
An explicit byte-sequence representation. Unknown encoding or format does not make its primary type unresolved.
A byte payload explicitly represented as opaque data, with no asserted text or structured interpretation. This is distinct from a pending or failed format classifier.
A decoded text representation with a pinned successful decoding rule; a file name alone does not establish it.
A structured document representation established by its declared parsing profile.
A complete document accepted by the strict JSON profile; JSON grammar acceptance and additional profile constraints are separately identified.
A complete SQL document accepted by a pinned parser and dialect grammar; syntax acceptance is not semantic validity, authorization, or execution success.
A Markdown document representation produced under a registered parser profile, separate from its source file role.
A typed value occurrence with a checked location and source revision.
A numeric value occurrence; Boolean is not a subtype.
An exact integer value. In the JSON profile, the source numeric lexeme has no decimal point or exponent.
An exact decimal value. JSON number lexemes with a decimal point or exponent retain this type even if their mathematical value is integral.
A Boolean value; never classified through Python's bool-is-an-int implementation detail.
A string value; numeric-looking characters do not establish numeric type.
An explicit null value; distinct from absence, unknown, failed parsing, and unresolved classification.
An ordered structured array occurrence whose materialized elements retain distinct occurrence identities.
A structured object occurrence with explicitly named members and checked child locators.
A checked application record representation validated against an identified schema; the original owning service remains authoritative.
The family of agent definitions, deployments, and runs. These are separate primary-type branches.
An agent definition view over a checked source. The generic type is used when no role is declared; it does not replace the owning definition record.
An agent definition with the single declared role coordination. This declaration does not grant capabilities, permissions, or decision authority.
An agent definition with the single declared role planning. This declaration does not grant capabilities, permissions, or decision authority.
An agent definition with the single declared role research. This declaration does not grant capabilities, permissions, or decision authority.
An agent definition with the single declared role coding. This declaration does not grant capabilities, permissions, or decision authority.
An agent definition with the single declared role review. This declaration does not grant capabilities, permissions, or decision authority.
An agent definition with the single declared role verification_assistance. This declaration does not grant capabilities, permissions, or decision authority.
An agent definition with the single declared role memory_curation. This declaration does not grant capabilities, permissions, or decision authority.
An agent definition with two or more explicit declared roles. Roles are checked facets, not additional primary types or inferred capabilities.
A deployment view bound to exactly one checked agent definition revision and checked runtime bindings; not an agent definition or run.
An agent execution occurrence bound to a checked definition and deployment with consistent definition lineage; execution state belongs to the existing run owner.
The family of workflow definitions and workflow runs, with separate primary-type branches.
A workflow definition view over a checked source. Generic definitions have no declared workflow kind; no execution is implied.
A workflow definition with the single declared kind coding; this type does not grant deployment, verification, or other policy authority.
A workflow definition with the single declared kind research; this type does not grant deployment, verification, or other policy authority.
A workflow definition with the single declared kind verification; this type does not grant deployment, verification, or other policy authority.
A workflow definition with the single declared kind memory_curation; this type does not grant deployment, verification, or other policy authority.
A workflow definition with the single declared kind evaluation; this type does not grant deployment, verification, or other policy authority.
A workflow definition with the single declared kind deployment; this type does not grant deployment, verification, or other policy authority.
A workflow definition with multiple explicit declared kinds; the kinds are facets and the primary type remains unique.
A workflow execution occurrence bound to a checked workflow definition revision; it is not a subtype of workflow.definition.

identity_contract.type_identity: A type ID has one immutable meaning. Publish a new ID/version and registry release for changed meaning; never silently reuse an ID or reinterpret existing assignments.
identity_contract.item_identity: item_id identifies a source occurrence or explicit representation, not a content digest. Equal values at distinct locators remain separate items.
identity_contract.ownership: Each typed item has exactly one checked source_owner_ref. It is a derived catalog view over the existing owner, not an independent authority, lifecycle, admission, or verification record.
identity_contract.subtyping: is_a is an explicit acyclic registry graph. Only its pinned transitive closure adds inherited type membership. contains, derived_from, defined_by and deployment references are not is_a.
identity_contract.membership_policy: Version 0.1.0 queries canonical primary equality by default; include_subtypes explicitly adds descendants. Other roles, formats and languages use declared facets or linked typed representations, not overlapping primary assignments.
identity_contract.file_primary_selection: For known file occurrences: exact AGENTS.md role first; otherwise a unique checked JSON/SQL role declaration, or its exact lowercase .json/.sql suffix when no conflicting declaration exists; otherwise dt:file. Conflicting role hints retain dt:file with unresolved role assessment. Decoded text and parsed documents are separate linked items.
identity_contract.definition_primary_selection: One declared agent role/workflow kind selects its corresponding subtype; two or more select composite; none selects the generic definition. Never infer a role from model identity or run behavior.
identity_contract.unresolved_primary: Use dt:unresolved only when the primary representation kind is unknown. Known bytes or file with unresolved format retains its known primary type.

declared_facets.sql_dialect: Exact dialect_id and dialect_version checked against the parser binding; syntax validity does not authorize execution.
declared_facets.file_basename: Exact source-provider basename; the AGENTS.md v1 classifier requires the exact spelling AGENTS.md.

classification_rules.rule: Establish the item kind from its checked source representation and payload schema; source hints alone cannot establish validated parse results.
Require a checked file occurrence with exact basename AGENTS.md. Do not infer text encoding, Markdown parse, applicability, trust, or instruction authority.
Require a checked file occurrence with an explicit SQL role declaration or exact lowercase .sql suffix. This establishes only the file role.
Require a checked file occurrence with an explicit JSON role declaration or exact lowercase .json suffix. This establishes only the file role, not successful strict-profile parsing.
Represent exact source bytes with checked length and digest. Encoding/format assessment is separate.
Require an explicit opaque-payload representation. Failed text or format recognition alone does not establish this role.
Decode all source bytes using strict UTF-8 with no replacement characters introduced by error recovery. A failure produces no validated text representation.

Parse one complete UTF-8 JSON document; reject trailing non-whitespace and non-JSON constants such as NaN/Infinity. Duplicate object keys are rejected by this additional profile constraint, not described as a JSON grammar prohibition. Preserve exact numeric lexemes and precision.
A JSON numeric lexeme with neither decimal point nor exponent produces dt:value.integer; preserve lexeme and canonical exact integer string, normalizing source -0 to canonical 0.

A JSON numeric lexeme containing decimal point or exponent produces dt:value.decimal; use exact decimal arithmetic, preserve original lexeme, and canonicalize without rounding or changing type. Resource overflow is explicit incomplete itemisation.

A trusted parser binding pins parser ID, exact parser release, dialect ID and dialect version. Accept all input including every statement under that grammar; unsupported dialect, partial parses and errors produce no validated SQL document. Never execute input to classify it.
Produce a separate document representation under a registered complete Markdown parser profile; do not infer this from AGENTS.md naming.
Read declared roles from the checked definition source; enforce the unique primary selection rule. Roles are descriptive and grant no capabilities or policy authority.
Check defined_by is an agent definition revision and runtime bindings belong to permitted existing owners; retain existing deployment ownership.
Check defined_by is an agent definition, deployment is an agent deployment, and both point to the same definition revision. Source run ownership remains authoritative.
Read declared workflow kinds from the checked definition and apply generic/single/composite selection without execution authority.
Check defined_by is a workflow definition revision and the existing source owner is the execution record authorized for that view.
Preserve a reason and unresolved classification; do not treat the fallback as matching other types.

itemisation_policy.default: Eagerly materialize every nested value in registered structured payloads, including container/root values and scalar children, using stable source-revision locators.
itemisation_policy.scope: Only the source payload selected by a registered materializer. Do not recursively itemize catalog bookkeeping, type assignments, schemas, query requests, cursors, provenance wrappers or the type registry itself.
itemisation_policy.child_identity: Bind each child to its document item, immediate container, exact locator and immutable source revision. Equal literal values at different JSON Pointers remain different occurrences.
itemisation_policy.json_locations: JSON Pointer relative to the parsed document. The root value has pointer ''. Object member pointers escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1; array indices are zero-based canonical decimal strings.
itemisation_policy.json_member_names: Object member names are locator metadata, not separately materialized string values. Every object, array and scalar VALUE is materialized under the registered policy; textual source characters and bookkeeping are not recursively indexed.
itemisation_policy.numeric_policy: Boolean is a separate kind. JSON integer lexemes contain no dot/exponent; decimal lexemes contain one or both. 1 and 1.0 retain different primary types even when canonical numeric values coincide.
itemisation_policy.incomplete_rule: Budget exhaustion, parser failure, unsupported materializer and unresolved source coverage are explicit outcomes. Do not mark a parent complete or claim all contained values are indexed when children are missing.
itemisation_policy.extension_rule: A new registered materializer publishes a new policy/generation and coverage manifest; it does not silently extend an existing snapshot.

query_contract.include_subtypes: Only true adds the pinned registry's descendant closure; containment and derivation never add a type match.
query_contract.facets: Optional registered facet filters use exact values and are ANDed with the type predicate. To find all coding-role agent definitions including composites, query agent.definition with descendants and declared_agent_role=coding.
query_contract.owner_boundary: Authenticated owner, principal and policy are supplied by the enclosing service command, never accepted from the model payload. Check every scope/source/snapshot reference against that owner.
query_contract.snapshot: Freeze source selection, item revisions, type registry, classifier generation, materialization policy and query predicate in an immutable server-owned manifest. Store or resolve the finite occurrence membership; do not recompute later pages from a moving live index.
query_contract.cursor: Opaque authenticated cursor binds principal, authorization boundary, snapshot, manifest, registry, generation, complete filter fingerprint and last ordering key. The client cannot change these fields when resuming.
query_contract.pagination: page_size controls delivery batches, not top-k selection. Advance only over the frozen membership with stable keyset ordering; never silently truncate for a runtime budget.
query_contract.access_change: Recheck current access/deletion boundaries before every page. If they change materially, invalidate the cursor and require a new snapshot/restart; never leak old content, membership, counts or existence from a revoked boundary.
query_contract.complete_claim: Exhaustive_registered_matches requires complete selection and delivery over the authorized frozen manifest. Exhaustive_scoped_typed_occurrences additionally requires complete ingestion, requested-type classification and required itemisation. Unknown/missing memberships and unparsed values are never silently treated as nonmatches.
query_contract.failure: Return explicit incomplete coverage and a reason for timeout, cancellation, failed ingestion/classification/itemisation, resource limit or unavailable snapshot. A final page alone cannot establish upstream completeness.
query_contract.scope_limit: Completeness applies only to the selected, authorized sources and declared item granularity; it does not claim to enumerate external or unadmitted data.

implementation_constraints: Exactly one immutable assignment row for each (item_id, item_revision_id, classification_generation_id).
Foreign keys/checks enforce checked source owner, registry type and typed parent/deployment/definition targets; JSON Schema alone cannot check these relationships.
Index primary_type_id and the pinned subtype closure with existing owner/scope partitions; type inventory never depends on embeddings or approximate nearest-neighbor recall.
The catalog cannot override authoritative source lifecycle, memory admission, active requirements, verification outcomes, capabilities or deletion policy.
Declared, validated, failed, profile-rejected and unresolved classifications remain distinct; an absent assignment is not evidence of a completed negative classifier.
